title: Discrete gravitational diagram technique and corrections to the Newtonian potential
summary: Starting from simplicial Regge gravity, we use a bell-shaped form of the measure obtained using functional integration over connection. A "hypercubic" structure is considered (some variables are frozen), it is described by the metric $g_{λμ}$ at the sites. The metric is parameterized to make the measure Lebesgue. The linear part of this parametrization leads to a discrete form of standard Feynman diagrams that approximates finite continuum diagrams and is finite for infinite ones; the nonlinear part gives new vertices and diagrams.
